declared: 2026-11-12 by Nusrat during Anisha's absence (P1; AUDIT.md section 15; Avatar/Config/upgrade_design.md section 3), before any development session that records the truth field ankle_height_m.
status: not measured yet: 0.0 is the v3 behaviour (ankles treated as floor points)

why.ankle_height_m: The 360 distance from the ankle keypoints (hri_perception.person_distance, source 'ankles') treats them as floor points, so every distance is too long by about d * h_ankle / (h_cam - h_ankle) (+0.105 m at 2.0 m for an ankle 0.08 m high and the camera at 1.60 m). The value is MEASURED, never fitted to distance errors: the median of the truth field ankle_height_m over all rows of the development looks (sunbox_m1, sunbox_f1) with phase idle (standing), from the first development session that has the field. The session folder is recorded in 'measured_from'.
